actionable_steps.citation: Love Is The Royal Path To Realise God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37 (2004), 2004-01-27
actionable_steps.step: Ask daily: 'Who am I? From where have I come? Whither am I going? How long will I be here?' — begin the inquiry; the entire spiritual search starts with these questions.

actionable_steps.citation: Treasure Spiritual Knowledge in Your Heart — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 26 (1993), 1993-04-04
actionable_steps.step: When you say 'my body, my mind,' notice the 'my' — you are not the body or the mind; they are instruments, and you are their owner, the Atma.

actionable_steps.citation: Treasure Spiritual Knowledge in Your Heart — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 26 (1993), 1993-04-04
actionable_steps.step: Don't follow the body; don't follow the mind — follow the conscience, for that is the Atma, the true self.

actionable_steps.citation: Know Thyself! You Will Know Everything — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 42 (2009), 2009-01-01
actionable_steps.step: Before chasing knowledge of the outer world, turn inward — knowing yourself first makes everything else clear.

actionable_steps.citation: Know Thyself! You Will Know Everything — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 42 (2009), 2009-01-01
actionable_steps.step: Remind yourself daily: 'I am the embodiment of divine Atma; the Atma is immanent in me.'

definition.citation: Love Is The Royal Path To Realise God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37 (2004), 2004-01-27
definition.quote: You have to do self-inquiry "Who am I? From where have I come? Whither am I going? How long will I be here?" The entire spiritual inquiry begins with these questions.

discourses.citation: Develop Educare And Be United — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 41 (2008), 2008-07-20
discourses.quote: First and foremost, enquire into yourself, "Who am I? Who am I? Who am I?" Then you will get the real answer. Are you the mind? Intellect? Subconscious mind? Ego? Body? You are none of these.

discourses.citation: Treasure Spiritual Knowledge in Your Heart — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 26 (1993), 1993-04-04
discourses.quote: You should say, "I am I. I am not the body, I am not the mind. The mind and body are only instruments. I am the owner, I am the master. Therefore, I am Atma."

discourses.citation: Know Thyself! You Will Know Everything — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 42 (2009), 2009-01-01
discourses.quote: Hence, there is no use asking, "Where is God?" Try to know about yourself, in the first instance. Then you will know everything.

discourses.citation: Lost and found — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 10 (1970), 1970-10-05
discourses.quote: The heavy tomes comprising the scriptures of all faiths and systems proclaim the answer in just two words: KNOW THYSELF.

make_it_real: Before you ask where God is tonight, ask who is asking — and sit with that question a while.
title: Self-inquiry

vahinis.quote: That ONE is the Atma, which through ignorance is mistaken as I. … "Know Thyself." Once you know yourself, everything else will automatically be clear.
